m_Description: In the lobby, press 'F1' (default key) when you are ready to play!
If you spawn stuck in a building, press 'F2' (default key) once at the start of the match to be teleported. Do not abuse it!
Outside the play area you take damage. Check the map for the next zone!
Press 'K' to hide or show the 3D marker!
Press 'Z' while running to enable the auto-run!
